f.title: Do not sell a lot after deleting or modifying label risk information until the product licence is amended
f.statement: Section 11(1)(c) lists the deletion or modification of risk information shown on any of the natural health product's labels as a change subject to s. 11(1) (the sale prohibition until the licence is amended, the actor and the caution/warning detail are from the section; see applicability).
f.applicability: Natural health products licensed under Part 1. From the section, not quoted: s. 11(1) provides that if the licensee makes this change, the licensee shall not sell any lot or batch of the product affected by the change unless the product licence is amended accordingly; para. (c) includes the deletion or modification of a caution, warning, contra-indication or known adverse reaction associated with its use. Timing: before sale of any affected lot or batch.

f.title: Do not sell a lot after a change affecting safety or efficacy until the product licence is amended
f.statement: Section 11(1)(h) covers a change affecting the natural health product's safety or efficacy that does not arise as a result of the fundamental changes listed in subparagraphs (i) to (iv) (a change for which the licensee may not sell an affected lot or batch until the product licence is amended; see applicability).
f.applicability: Natural health products licensed under Part 1. From the section, not quoted: s. 11(1) provides that if the licensee makes this change, the licensee shall not sell any lot or batch of the product affected by the change unless the product licence is amended accordingly. Timing: before sale of any affected lot or batch.
f.exceptions: From the section, not quoted: para. (h) excludes changes arising from (i) a change to the quantity of a medicinal ingredient per dosage unit, (ii) the addition or substitution of a medicinal ingredient, (iii) a change to its dosage form, or (iv) a change to its recommended route of administration; those are fundamental changes requiring a new product licence under s. 13.

f.title: Notify the Minister within 60 days of adding risk information to labels and provide the label text
f.statement: Where section 12(1) applies, the licensee shall act within 60 days after the day on which the change is made: notify the Minister of the change and, for label risk-information additions, provide the label text (the duties and the change type are from the section; see applicability).
f.applicability: Natural health products licensed under Part 1. From the section, not quoted: s. 12(1) applies when the licensee makes a change listed in s. 12(2), including (f) the addition of risk information to any of its labels (including a caution, warning, contra-indication or known adverse reaction associated with its use). Within 60 days after the day on which the change is made the licensee shall (a) notify the Minister of the change and (b) for changes in s. 12(2)(d) to (f), provide the Minister with the text of each label used in conjunction with the product since the change.

f.title: Provide safety information within 15 days when the Minister requests it
f.statement: When the Minister requests safety information under section 16, it is to be provided within 15 days after the day on which the request is received ('received' and the rest of the provision from the section; see applicability).
f.applicability: Natural health products licensed under Part 1. From the section, not quoted: s. 16: if the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that a natural health product may no longer be safe when used under the recommended conditions of use, the Minister may request that the licensee provide information and documents demonstrating that the product is safe when used under the recommended conditions of use.
f.exceptions: Permitted power of the Minister; s. 16 states no separate licensee 'shall comply' duty, but failure to provide within the required period is a ground for a stop-sale direction under s. 17(1)(a) (row 0005).

f.applicability: Natural health products licensed under Part 1.
